main_text.head: AUCTORITAS ORACULI Per HISORIAM Implementi asserta.
main_text.p: §. 1. Videamus jam in historiâ, quænam præco-nium euangelii, seu aduentum Christi cum euangelio regni, consecuta fuerunt; idque conuenienter huic prophetiæ. Prodierunt statim diuersimodè de Christi persona sentientes, dum alii Iesum de regno cœlorum loquentem, omnemque ejus rationem exponentem, lubenter audirent, eumque sequerentur sedulò: alii vero ejus doctrinam, utpote suis præconceptis opinionibus ac præjudiciis minùs consentientem respuebant, nec ejus miraculis se ad fidem adduci patiebantur. Priores facti sunt credentes, qui Iesum profitentes esse Christum, veram vitæ viam in ejus doctrinâ inveniri fide tenebant. Posteriores autem facti sunt ejus inimici; qui eum ut seductorem populi damnarunt; eiusque doctrinam de ratione salutis, peccatori spem vitæ exponentem, magnâ cum animi aversione rejecerunt.

page.notes: The large decorated initial is a V, so the first word is Videamus. The printed "Ideamus" is the initial's ornament. "respuebant" is read from the scan as "refpuebant". The section mark "N." opens the second paragraph as printed. The paragraph ends mid-word at "analo-" and continues on the next page. Italics are read from the scan for Iesum, Christum, and the phrases marked above. No catchword or signature is visible.
